reviews.text: Very nice, moisturizing but doesn’t leave a sticky or oily feeling. It’s odorless and spreads nicely. Doesn’t irritate or break out the skin. All in all a great product
reviews.zh: 好好，滋潤但唔會黏或者油膩。冇味，推開好順。唔會刺激或者令皮膚爆痘。總括嚟講係好產品。

reviews.text: Use this sun stick if your priority is oil control, a matte finish, and easy reapplication on the go. It's a standout choice for those with oily and combination skin who struggle with typical greasy sunscreens. However, if you are very sensitive to fragrance or have dry skin, you might want to patch test or opt for a different formula.
reviews.zh: 如果你最睇重控油、啞光效果，同埋外出時易於補擦，就可以用呢支防曬棒。對於受一般油膩防曬所困擾嘅油性同混合性皮膚人士嚟講，佢係出眾嘅選擇。不過，如果你對香味好敏感或者係乾性皮膚，你可能要先做貼布測試，或者揀另一款配方。

reviews.text: Love this sun stick! has an instant cooling feeling on the skin when applying it, and little to no fragrance that sticks around. Leaves the skin looking and feeling moisturized but not overly shiny.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢支防曬棒！塗落皮膚時即刻有清涼感，香味好淡，而且唔會留好耐。令皮膚睇落同感覺都有滋潤，但係唔會太油光。

reviews.text: this sunscreen is definitely cooling! it’s nice on hot days to help cool down the skin. i love the sun protection, enjoy the cooling feeling, and think it’s a great product. only took off one star because it kind of feels like chapstick almost? the texture isn’t necessarily bad, but it’s not always the most comfortable because it’s like a balm but it’s not super dry, it’s moisturizing and a little slippy, but it’s a balm like texture. i prefer the blue tocobo sun stick, but that one is more mattifying & smooth, so this is probably be better for dry skin folks that don’t mind the balminess. i have dry skin (with a little combination on my cheeks and forehead, but leaning mostly dry) and i enjoy this, i just can’t always handle the texture. the matte blue sun stick is less balmy but leaves the skin with almost a powdery finish. both are great, just important to know the differences if you’re looking at both.
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬真係好清涼！熱天用嚟幫助皮膚降溫都好啱。我好鍾意防曬效果、享受清涼感，覺得係好產品。只係扣咗一粒星，因為感覺有啲似潤唇膏？質地唔一定唔好，但係未必次次都好舒服，因為佢似膏狀，但係唔算好乾身，佢滋潤，帶少少滑溜，有膏狀質感。我比較鍾意藍色 Tocobo 防曬棒，但嗰款更加控油、順滑，所以呢款可能更適合唔介意膏狀質感嘅乾性皮膚人士。我係乾性皮膚（面頰同額頭有少少混合，但主要偏乾），我用得幾開心，只係我唔係次次都頂得住嗰種質地。啞光嘅藍色防曬棒就冇咁膏，但係會令皮膚有近乎粉狀嘅效果。兩款都好好，只係如果你兩款都考慮，知道分別好重要。

reviews.text: Definitely cools the skin and more lasting than some other sunsticks I have tried that "claim" to be cooling. I prefer the Tocobo Cotton Sunstick thought because that one matte-ifies my skin, whereas this one makes my face more on the wet/oilier side, but doesn't feel oily.
reviews.zh: 絕對有清涼效果，比我試過嘅一啲自稱有清涼感嘅防曬棒更持久。不過我更鍾意 Tocobo Cotton Sunstick，因為嗰款令我皮膚啞光，而呢款令我面更加偏濕、偏油，但係摸落唔會油膩。

reviews.text:
Спф очень хороший но для меня немного жирноват
Оставляет немного неприятный липко жирный слой который не впитывается
В пределах города где пыль ветер все будет липнуть на лицо даже для защиты тату немного некомфортно
reviews.zh:
防曬效果好好，但係對我嚟講有少少油膩。
會留低一層有啲唔舒服、黏膩油膩嘅薄膜，唔會被吸收。
喺城市入面，有塵同大風，啲嘢都會黏住面，即使係用嚟保護紋身，都有啲唔舒服。

reviews.text: Very cool for my combination skin. It doesn't look so greasy in the T-zone. Does not leave white marks on the skin, absorbs quickly enough and when you move for a long time in the sun you don't get white water on your face. It has a very pleasant light fragrance. The photo shows the product consumption per month if used every day.
reviews.zh: 用喺我嘅混合性皮膚上非常清爽。T 字位睇落唔會太油膩。唔會留白痕，吸收夠快；而且喺太陽底下行好耐，面上都唔會出現白色嘅水。香味好輕、好舒服。相片顯示咗每日都用嘅每月用量。

reviews.text: It has a strong fragrance, it smells nice but not my cup of tea to be honest. I personally prefer the other one “cotton soft sun stick”! It also doesn’t leave my face matte compared to the cotton sun stick
reviews.zh: 佢香味好濃，聞落好好聞，但老實講唔係我嘅菜。我個人更鍾意另一款「cotton soft sun stick」！同 cotton sun stick 比較，佢亦唔會令我面啞光。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
